From Uruguay to the Atlantic, Uruguay will be free. Give it back to the Chirúa. From the Yuzumikinta to the Gulf, Mexico will be free. Give it back to the Maya. Wow, how does that sound? Silly, right? say it about Israel. From the river to the sea, give it back to who? Israel is carved in stone in Egypt over 3,000 years ago, and the word Jew comes from Judah, right here. Jews didn't colonize Judea. Judea is where Jews come from. So how silly does that chant sound now? Fine, let's free everyone. Ready?
